fact: UNDP with iCampus Liberia, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the University of Liberia and UniPod launched LiYEPA, a six-month pilot accelerator with incubation, mentorship and prototype support, on 30 June 2026, aiming at 100-120 innovators, with applications open.

The University Innovation Pod-Liberia (UniPod), a makerspace with digital media labs and workstations run by iCampus Liberia with UNDP, was officially launched by Vice President Koung; no incubation cohort is described.
